The condition $\pi(j)<\pi(k)<\pi(i)$ with $i<j<k$ says that, read left to right, the values at the three positions are largest, smallest, middle. So each rotated cycle is an occurrence of the pattern 312 at positions $i<j<k$.

For any fixed set of three positions, the relative order of the three values is equally likely to be each of the $3! = 6$ orderings across all permutations. So exactly $\frac{n!}{6}$ permutations have the pattern at those positions.

Summing over all $\binom{n}{3}$ choices of positions:

$$\text{Total} = \binom{n}{3}\cdot\frac{n!}{6}.$$

For $n=10$:

$$\binom{10}{3}\cdot\frac{10!}{6} = 120\cdot 604800 = 72{,}576{,}000.$$

ANSWER: 72576000
